Using the geometric mean property for terms \(a_5,a_7,a_9\):

\[
a_7^2 = a_5 a_9
\]

By Vieta,

\[
a_5 a_9 = 9
\]

So

\[
a_7^2 = 9 \implies a_7 = \pm 3
\]

Since the quadratic has product \(9>0\) and sum \(-2016<0\), both roots \(a_5,a_9\) are negative. Thus \(a_7\) must also be negative.

\[
\boxed{-3}
\]
